I'm replacing the single multi-output ridge with a separate kernel ridge for each drug. Each drug is fit only on the lines where it was actually measured, instead of filling missing AUCs with the drug mean, which pulls predictions toward the mean. Each drug's shrinkage is picked by inner grouped CV, half-weighted toward the best setting across all drugs, because a single alpha=5000 is unlikely to suit both the weak-signal and the strong-signal drugs. Because the kernel matrices are only lines × lines, all 200 drugs, 5 inner folds and 7 alpha values cost only about 1,000 small eigendecompositions per outer fold.
